name: Cooum Basin Flood Escalation & Infrastructure Severance
description: Deterministic competition demonstration walking through flood surge, bridge failure cascade, dynamic rerouting, offline field reporting, and state reconciliation.

steps.title: Baseline Operational State
steps.narration: All emergency systems nominal. Digital Twin reflects authoritative baseline state (Version 42). Primary road corridors and bridges open.

steps.title: Flood Inundation Scenario (+1.0m)
steps.narration: Phase 10 Flood Simulation models a +1.0m water surge. Inundation extent expands over low-lying Cooum basin sectors.

steps.title: Structural Bridge Failure Cascade
steps.narration: Water level breaches causeway clearance. Digital Twin triggers Bridge B-001 failure, cascading closure to arterial Road R-101.

steps.title: Phase 08 Dynamic Rerouting Triggered
steps.narration: Emergency router detects route severance, validates graph connectivity, and computes optimal Northern Flyover detour (+1.4 km, +2.7 min).

steps.title: Field Connectivity Loss (Offline Mode)
steps.narration: Severe storm severs cellular backhaul. Field Officer #42 device transitions into offline mode. Local storage engine engages.

steps.title: Offline Incident Report Captured
steps.narration: Field Officer files critical flood entrapment report (12 citizens trapped). Payload persisted securely in offline queue.

steps.title: Connectivity Restored & Synchronized
steps.narration: Field gateway connection restored. Queued event validates schema, synchronizes with central authority, bumping Digital Twin to Version 44.

steps.title: Phase 11 What-If Counterfactual Sandbox
steps.narration: Coordinator asks 'What happens if hospital H-002 capacity drops to 0?'. Evaluated in isolated forked state without mutating live state.
